Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write code that normalizes extracted expense fields into a standard JSON schema using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Textract AnalyzeExpense:
  Service: Amazon Textract AnalyzeExpense
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: analyze_expense
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/API_AnalyzeExpense.html

Option 2 — Alibaba OCR invoice recognition:
  Service: Alibaba Cloud OCR invoice recognition
  SDK: alibabacloud_ocr_api
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognizeInvoice
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ocr

Option 3 — Azure DI prebuilt invoice:
  Service: Azure Document Intelligence prebuilt invoice
  SDK: azure-ai-documentintelligence
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: begin_analyze_document
  Setup hints: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT, AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/document-intelligence/prebuilt/invoice

Option 4 — Mindee:
  Service: Mindee Invoice OCR
  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, invoice
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.mindee.com/docs/python-sdk

Option 5 — Document AI Invoice Parser:
  Service: Google Document AI processors
  SDK: google-cloud-documentai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: process_document
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/processors-list#processor_invoice-parser

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
from azure.ai.documentintelligence import DocumentIntelligenceClient
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential
import os

def normalize_expense_data(document_url: str = None, document_data: bytes = None, content_type: str = None) -> dict:
    """
    Normalizes extracted expense fields into a standard JSON schema using Azure Document Intelligence.

    Args:
        document_url (str, optional): The URL to the document to analyze. Defaults to None.
        document_data (bytes, optional): The document data as bytes. Must be provided with content_type. Defaults to None.
        content_type (str, optional): The content type of the document_data (e.g., "application/pdf"). Required if document_data is provided. Defaults to None.

    Returns:
        dict: A dictionary representing the normalized expense data.
    """
    endpoint = os.environ.get("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT")
    key = os.environ.get("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY")

    if not endpoint or not key:
        raise ValueError("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT and AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY environment variables must be set.")

    document_intelligence_client = DocumentIntelligenceClient(
        endpoint=endpoint, credential=AzureKeyCredential(key)
    )

    if document_url:
        poller = document_intelligence_client.begin_analyze_document(
            "prebuilt-invoice", document_url=document_url
        )
    elif document_data and content_type:
        poller = document_intelligence_client.begin_analyze_document(
            "prebuilt-invoice", document_data=document_data, content_type=content_type
        )
    else:
        raise ValueError("Either 'document_url' or 'document_data' with 'content_type' must be provided.")

    invoice = poller.result()

    extracted_expense = {
        "vendor_name": None,
        "invoice_id": None,
        "invoice_date": None,
        "total_amount": None,
        "currency": None,
        "line_items": []
    }

    if invoice.documents:
        # Assuming there's at least one document (invoice) found
        first_invoice = invoice.documents[0]
        fields = first_invoice.fields

        # Vendor Name
        vendor_name_field = fields.get("VendorName")
        if vendor_name_field and vendor_name_field.value:
            extracted_expense["vendor_name"] = vendor_name_field.value

        # Invoice ID
        invoice_id_field = fields.get("InvoiceId")
        if invoice_id_field and invoice_id_field.value:
            extracted_expense["invoice_id"] = invoice_id_field.value

        # Invoice Date
        invoice_date_field = fields.get("InvoiceDate")
        if invoice_date_field and invoice_date_field.value:
            # Azure returns datetime.date object, convert to ISO string
            extracted_expense["invoice_date"] = invoice_date_field.value.isoformat()

        # Total Amount and Currency
        total_due_field = fields.get("TotalDue")
        if total_due_field and total_due_field.value is not None:
            extracted_expense["total_amount"] = float(total_due_field.value)
            if total_due_field.currency_symbol:
                extracted_expense["currency"] = total_due_field.currency_symbol
            elif total_due_field.value_currency:
                extracted_expense["currency"] = total_due_field.value_currency
        else: # Try to reconstruct from SubTotal and TotalTax if TotalDue is not found or has no value
            sub_total_field = fields.get("SubTotal")
            total_tax_field = fields.get("TotalTax")
            
            sub_total_value = sub_total_field.value if sub_total_field and sub_total_field.value is not None else 0.0
            total_tax_value = total_tax_field.value if total_tax_field and total_tax_field.value is not None else 0.0

            if sub_total_value > 0 or total_tax_value > 0: # Only assign if there's a meaningful value
                extracted_expense["total_amount"] = float(sub_total_value) + float(total_tax_value)

            # Try to get currency from SubTotal or TotalTax
            currency_source_field = None
            if sub_total_field and (sub_total_field.currency_symbol or sub_total_field.value_currency):
                currency_source_field = sub_total_field
            elif total_tax_field and (total_tax_field.currency_symbol or total_tax_field.value_currency):
                currency_source_field = total_tax_field
            
            if currency_source_field:
                if currency_source_field.currency_symbol:
                    extracted_expense["currency"] = currency_source_field.currency_symbol
                elif currency_source_field.value_currency:
                    extracted_expense["currency"] = currency_source_field.value_currency
        
        # Line Items
        items_field = fields.get("Items")
        if items_field and items_field.value:
            for item in items_field.value:
                item_fields = item.value
                line_item = {
                    "description": None,
                    "quantity": None,
                    "unit_price": None,
                    "total_price": None
                }

                description_field = item_fields.get("Description")
                if description_field and description_field.value:
                    line_item["description"] = description_field.value

                quantity_field = item_fields.get("Quantity")
                if quantity_field and quantity_field.value is not None:
                    line_item["quantity"] = float(quantity_field.value)

                unit_price_field = item_fields.get("UnitPrice")
                if unit_price_field and unit_price_field.value is not None:
                    line_item["unit_price"] = float(unit_price_field.value)

                amount_field = item_fields.get("Amount")
                if amount_field and amount_field.value is not None:
                    line_item["total_price"] = float(amount_field.value)

                extracted_expense["line_items"].append(line_item)

    return extracted_expense
